TenantSecurityTenantChangeLog.name: TenantSecurityTenantChangeLog
TenantSecurityTenantChangeLog.description: Tracks changes to Security Center tenant fields. Each record represents a single field change on a tenant.

Field.description: The name of the field that was changed.

Name.description: The unique identifier for the change log record.

NewValue.description: The new value of the field that was changed.

OldValue.description: The latest value of the field before it was changed.

Tenant.description: The ID of the tenant associated with this change log record.
